level.description: Rune level. character-build and build-allocate both return it as `level`.

upgrade.description: The weapon's upgrade level. Leave it out for the level bands alone.

somber.description: True when that upgrade is on a somber weapon, which counts as two and a half standard levels. weapon-lookup's max_upgrade of 10 is the tell.

area.description: An area name, when the user named one — 'Stormveil', 'Raya Lucaria'. Matched loosely, and answered from the softest table here.
